name: write-like-me
description: Write, rewrite, or reply in the user's evidence-backed voice while preserving meaning and removing generic AI texture.

interface.shortDescription: Keep the meaning. Learn your evidence-backed voice.
interface.longDescription: Write Like Me by HopLittleBunny drafts or rewrites personal prose, uses semantic safeguards and applied linguistic evidence to preserve meaning and language variety, builds a portable English writing pattern, verifies rewrite integrity, and learns only corrections the user confirms.
defaultPrompt: Write this email in my voice and keep it paste-ready.
Audit or clean the AI texture in this draft.
Learn my writing pattern from a few answers.
